prompt: django install tutorial
response:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Django + Django REST Framework Install & Bootstrap Tutorial
set -euo pipefail

# 1. Create and activate a Python virtual environment
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate

# 2. Upgrade pip and install Django + DRF
python -m pip install --upgrade pip
pip install django djangorestframework

# 3. Verify Django version
python -m django --version

# 4. Scaffold project ('config') and first app ('core')
django-admin startproject config .
python manage.py startapp core

# 5. Apply initial migrations & run system checks
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py check

# 6. Start local development server (http://127.0.0.1:8000)
python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000

prompt: fastapi install tutorial
response:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# FastAPI + Uvicorn Quickstart Install Tutorial
set -euo pipefail

python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate

python -m pip install --upgrade pip
pip install fastapi uvicorn[standard]

cat <<'EOF' > main.py
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI(title="AI API")


@app.get("/health")
async def health() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"status": "ok"}
EOF

uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# FFmpeg H.264 MP4 Encode & Probe Utility
set -euo pipefail

INPUT="${1:-input.mov}"
OUTPUT="${2:-output_faststart.mp4}"

ffmpeg -y -i "$INPUT" \
  -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 23 -pix_fmt yuv420p \
  -movflags +faststart "$OUTPUT"

ffmpeg -i "$OUTPUT" 2>&1 | grep -E "Duration:|Video:" || true
